kaggle.comment: Official Kaggle remote MCP (OAuth, no token to store). Tools: notebooks (start/poll/output), datasets, models, competitions, benchmarks.

kaggle-local.comment: Community stdio server with the Kaggle API behind it. Use when you want non-interactive automation (CI, scripts) instead of the OAuth browser flow. Set KAGGLE_API_TOKEN to a KGAT_ token from kaggle.com/settings.
